Class CultureVector

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.culture.CultureVector
public class CultureVector extends Object
Represents the cultural signature of a population. Uses a 3-dimensional vector (RGB) for visualization and distance calculation. Axes (Abstract): - Red: Aggression / Expansionism - Green: Commerce / Collectivism - Blue: Spirituality / Tradition
